notes.title: TOBOR Arrives on November 16th, 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LyhdxRrUWrs;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081310/TOBOR/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/8b7ebab1219367bbaba69ade783d0781b1a4a048.png[/img]

TOBOR is an experimental story-based surveillance simulation game where the player plays as Tobor, a spy robot of RA Corporation, and explore ‘Undercroft’ using a surveillance system. Depending on the many choices that the player makes, players can enjoy not only changing the story inside the surveillance feeds, but also experience multiple endings.

The game was inspired by New York experimental theatre “Sleep No More”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/1c45ee1cbb91c9dd6269a0abaf6baa3aafb0a3a1.png[/img]

While the objective of Tobor is to observe the inhabitants, there is much revealed along the way of what connections undercroft has with a character named Dr. Goralini. The gamer gathers intelligence by eavesdropping and scanning objects and uses their wits to make choices throughout the game leading to a different ending. The player is given 6 days to accomplish their given mission. The official release will reveal all the endings of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/dca974c56006e227ef289708152d729204429e24.png[/img]

- Single Player 2D surveillance simulation game 
- A compelling tragic story with 5 characters to follow
- Investigate to find out the truth about ‘Undercroft’ 
- Observe 16 camera feeds that run simultaneously
- Learn to use the surveillance system to eavesdrop, scan objects and gather intelligence
- Find out the truth behind the weird dreams that become a reality
- Be careful on the choices you make as it will change the story
- Choices Matter game with multiple endings
- Language support available for English, Korean

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/5e3fcdc0843da9553695d3693ce9fb90953054b1.png[/img]

- Observe LIVE FEEDS of FIVE SUBJECTS
- All the subjects have their own background story and personality
- They all react differently to the same event that occurs in the same space
- Replay the game to see the different perspectives

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/054c77d1faabec37e9ade380761b22225f56f6bc.png[/img]

We plan to release media and press steam keys a little early! 
If you are media or press, feel free to checkout our PR Kit and reach out to us.

notes.title: World of Mines Creators Edition is Switching to Free
notes.content:
Howdy everyone, 

Thank you for playing WoM Creator's Edition on Steam. 
We created WoM Creator's Edition to be a Steam workshop game and we thought that the more players participate on the the steam workshop the better. So we've decided to switch from a paid game to a free game. 

As of yet, we're not certain if we will implement In-App Purchases down the line. But we are open to all possibilities moving forward as we will consent the community regarding these updates. In the meantime, we hope minesweeper players can enjoy the free game and the workshop community with more than 300 levels to play. 

We are currently talking with Steam regarding the exact time. Stay tuned for more updates. 

Additionally, note that these changes: 

- Everyone who owns the game will continue to own it. 
- Anyone who acquired a game for free won't receive trading cards unless the game has in-app purchases. 

Thank you! 


- Team Cogoo

notes.title: World of Mines Creator's Edition 2.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

Today, the team is really happy to launch World of Mines Creator's Edition version 2.0.
Our main focus for this major update was to make it a more immersive Steam Workshop game. Version 1.0 used to be a minesweeper game with a world map twist, but now we have made major improvements in many areas of the game. Hence we have taken the 1.0 version into a classic mode. 

So let's take a look like how the game has improved. 

Our Main home provides a scroll view of many different themes. 
We wanted to make it much easier to find interesting pixel mines levels. 
The community now has over 150 user created workshop levels. We greatly appreciate the awesome creators who have made this possible. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/a76d029f728560a15a32ee4c5923ee02d03fd5bb.gif[/img]

Most importantly, we have technically re-created the editor. Available now, players can focus on creating your favorite pixel art with so many more colors without the need to purchase them using mines. 
We really hope that players can unleash their creativity using this powerful tool. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/d05a618dc465bc9417ecbf92bed3e9e805d9cd4a.gif[/img]

We tried really hard to keep the original essence of the Steam Workshop game. 
We also tried to stick to our original concept "Classic PC game with a twist". 
We wanted to make the best time killing game even better. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/5d944ffc1a45a80273bff93a8b975f920412cc89.gif[/img]


We look forward to seeing the community grow along with many more pixel art levels coming up. 

Many thanks, 

Team Cogoo

notes.title: [Coming Soon] Version 2.0 Major Update Devlog
notes.content:
Dear All, 

Today we are very happy to announce that version 2.0 will be updated in the near future. 

Recently, one of our players(@Nemexis) spent about 20 hours to make a workshop map called Starry Night. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/d804f638c0bf7f07ab829d9b6f49474614929978.png[/img]

Here is a link the The Starry Night map. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2915843762

We were so surprised and inspired, the team has decided to go Version 2.0.
Thank you so much for taking the effort to inspire our community of players [b]Nemexis. 
[/b] You helped us to wake up to more possibilities. 
We believe current players will most likely be surprised by the update, as we believe it can look and feel like a different game. 

So here is what we are updating on Version 2.0. 

[u][b]1) We are turning all creator's edition highlighting the Workshop in Steam. [/b][/u]
- Improved palette for pixel art. 
- Many more colors(No more spending mines to unlock new colors).
- New auto save featured will be supported as Nemexis requested. 
- Current two step edition(Tile making & Pixel Art) will be combined to 1 Step. Just focus on the pixel art and the tiles will be automatically created. 
- New short keys will be matched to the keyboards. (e.g., Number 1, 2, 3 for Brush tool, Eraser tool, Pipette tool)
- Thumbnail images can now be chosen by the editor/creator (Hidden mode, Grayscale mode, Full Color) 

[u][b]2) New Gallery Mode [/b][/u]
- Players will be able to view their pixel art collection (Created by map creators in the workshop) under a new Gallery mode. 
- New sorting algorithm of your collection 

[u][b]3) World Map feature [/b][/u]
- This feature and content will move to 'Classic World of Mines' 
- Your world map will still be there, but it will be pushed back in terms of priority to make the game more creator oriented. 
- All classic colors available for coloring will be unlocked. 

We believe the game can support more pixel art creators to enjoy and focus on the art and unleash creativity. 

Thank you so much to all the creators in our workshop community. 

Cheers, 

Team Cogoo 
- Please fell free to questions on the comments. =)

notes.title: World of Mines Creator's Edition will be Officially Released on May 10th, 2022!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42253148/5d8c1ade01b2b3d0265c69d0d405b9f0a2cef667.png[/img]

Hello all, 

The team is really happy to announce that [b]World of Mines Creator's Edition[/b] will be officially going live on [u][b]May 10th, 2022[/b][/u]. We are working hard to test the many features and also plan for the future updates of the game. 

At the core, the team is confident that we wish to enhance the game along with the players on our Steam community. We wish to once again accentuate that the team is really open to new ideas and that your feedback regarding the game really matters. For these reasons, we have implemented Steam workshops where players can actually have fun creating their own maps of the classic fun.
